Ana (Product): quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A re: pricing & usage policies. two frequent customer confusions: (A) how bursts differ between Hosted vs Dedicated; (B) when credits are charged during retries.

Leo (CEO): short recap: rate limits are enforced separately from billing. Hosted customers get a short burst credit buffer; Dedicated customers rely primarily on reserved capacity and contract terms for bursts. Billing is applied when the model emits tokens.

Sandeep (Eng): adding the enforcement model we use: ingress TokenBucket -> runtime admission -> billing at emit. config example: `billing_point: "on_emit"`, `burst_window_minutes: 5`, `default_rps: 100`.

Jess (Engineering): Hosted: small temporary burst window (~5min) that draws from credits; after that requests may queue briefly or yield 429s depending on route SLO. Dedicated: small bursts often served from idle reserved capacity (no credits) up to `burst_factor` in contract; then throttled.

Mike (Finance): note on overages: Hosted usage deducts credits or invoices per plan. Dedicated/enterprise overages billed per contract terms; for big deviations we surface alerts and require account owner approval unless auto-billing is enabled.

Lisa (Support): can we have a one-paragraph paste-ready FAQ for customers? they keep confusing 429 vs charged tokens.

Ana (Product): suggested paste: "If you hit your plan rate limit you may see a 429. Tokens are only charged when the model actually emits tokens. Hosted customers have a short burst buffer that may consume credits; Dedicated customers may cover small bursts with reserved capacity per your contract. If you're unsure, send your org id to support and well check your burst and credit status."

Jess (Engineering): operational tip: retries that reach the model can cause duplicate token consumption. recommend clients use idempotency for non-streaming requests or cancel duplicate requests early.

Sandeep (Eng): i'll open a small docs PR with exact default numbers and an internal runbook for SEs.

Ana (Product): action items: @Sandeep create PR + FAQ, @Jess add runtime note about `billing_point`, @Mike confirm overage workflow, @Lisa paste FAQ into Zendesk. leaving thread open for additional edge cases. :thumbsup:
